posts.subject: Exp problem ?
posts.bodyHtml:
Oh hi guys,


For about... maybe 1 week I can't gain anymore exp even if I kill someone level 1000+. Some says there's a level cap that has been implemented weeks ago, if this is true, that's kinda sucks cuz many people can't upgrade anymore their skills and they can't do anything against guys who are maxed out... Can't you augment the level cap or... just delete it ? That's kinda unfair for everyone except the maxed out guys.


Thanks for all (and I'm really really sorry for my bad english ^^)


Kao

For me, there are 2 options now:


1.: Remove the cap.


2.: Reset all the users that are way above the cap.


Otherwise it'd be pretty unfair for those who joined the server later because the'll never have the chance to be maxed out.

Following changes have been made to the SurfDM server:


- changed levelcap to level 1000 (enough that everyone can max out on all skills)
- set max firerate level to 5
- set max long jump level to 5
- removed clip size skill
- removed resupply skill


- round restart delay changed from 15 seconds to 8 seconds
Change to lvl 1000 ? When ? I'm lvl 719 and can't gain any level Oo

It should already be updated.
I tried reloading the plugin now - if that does not work I'll have to restart the server.


Please report, if the changes still haven't been updated.


BlackFire

Everything fine 🙂


Thanks Black I appreciate your help aswell as the rest of the admins 🙂
